query:running_total_after_step.answer_hint: set "answer" to the requested running total as an integer
query:running_total_after_step.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "running_values" to an array of [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel boxes around the printed running values through the target step, and "target_step_label" to an array containing one [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel box around the target step label

query:first_total_at_least_threshold.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact contribution-step label as a string, or "unanswerable" if no visible contribution step satisfies the threshold rule
query:first_total_at_least_threshold.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "running_values" to an array of [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel boxes around the printed running values checked through the answer step, and "threshold_label" to an array containing one [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel box around the threshold label; if the answer is "unanswerable", use an empty object

query:first_total_at_most_threshold.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact contribution-step label as a string, or "unanswerable" if no visible contribution step satisfies the threshold rule
query:first_total_at_most_threshold.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "running_values" to an array of [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel boxes around the printed running values checked through the answer step, and "threshold_label" to an array containing one [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel box around the threshold label; if the answer is "unanswerable", use an empty object

query:remove_step_final_total.answer_hint: set "answer" to the counterfactual final total as an integer
query:remove_step_final_total.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "final_total_value", "target_contribution_value", and "target_step_label" to [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel boxes around those three visible witnesses

query:reverse_step_final_total.answer_hint: set "answer" to the counterfactual final total as an integer
query:reverse_step_final_total.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "final_total_value", "target_contribution_value", and "target_step_label" to [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel boxes around those three visible witnesses
